name: Touch of Despair
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 1, bard 0, bloodrager 1, lathspell 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 minute or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell imbues the target with a sense of impending loss and sadness.

For the duration of the spell or until it is discharged, the target takes a -1 penalty on saves vs. fear and despair effects. As an immediate action the cast of this spell can discharge it to impose a -1 penalty on the target’s next attack, ability or skill check, saving throw, or damage roll.
